tools.name: get_insider_filings
tools.description: SEC Form 3/4/5 filing index: one row per filing (accession_number) with company, ticker, document_type ('3' initial, '4' change, '5' annual; '4/A' etc. amendments), all reporting_owners and row counts. Source: SEC's quarterly bulk data, 2006 on; newer filings come from the daily feed (source 'sec_edgar_live': Forms 4 and 5 only, envelope fields null, is_amendment unknown). A ticker search also covers symbols the issuer no longer lists. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_insider_filings

document_type.description: Exact: '3' initial, '4' change, '5' annual, or amendment '3/A', '4/A', '5/A'.

tools.name: get_insider_holdings
tools.description: Insider positions from SEC Form 3/4/5 filings: one row per holding line reported by a director, officer or 10%+ owner. Source: SEC's quarterly bulk Form 3/4/5 data set, 2006 on. Shares and value are as of the filing (after its transaction), not live. A ticker search also returns the issuer's rows under symbols it no longer lists or another issuer's symbol (on its CIK): ticker is as filed; see current_ticker and issuer_relation. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_insider_holdings

company_name.description: Substring; 1-3 characters match a whole word.

merge_co_reports.description: Default true: a position co-owners each report is one row naming every filer; false: one row per filing (double-counts).

holding_type.description: nonderiv: e.g. common stock; deriv: options, RSUs, warrants, convertibles.

tools.name: get_insider_transactions
tools.description: SEC Form 4/5 insider transactions by officers, directors and 10% owners: one row per transaction line of one filing, non-derivative and derivative (filter is_derivative). shares and price_per_share are nullable and null is not zero: read total_value. Code P alone is not an open-market buy (SEC: open market OR private, any security): use transaction_codes=['P'], is_derivative=false, include_non_open_market=false. Default data_source bulk_v2 is SEC's quarterly bulk data, 2006 to the last published quarter; on simple recency queries newer filings are merged from the live feed (coverage_warning says so). A ticker also finds rows filed under the issuer's former symbols (ticker_resolution); share classes are not merged. price_check and volume_check say whether each plausibility check ran; a null verdict means not checked, never fine. Raw market values (price_range_low/high, daily_range, shares_vs_daily_volume) are Tiingo data served on paid plans only; elsewhere they are omitted and named in licensed_fields_withheld. A disclosure_date keeps gaining late filings: re-query rather than reuse a window. Values are SEC's bytes, never corrected; source_metadata flags known SEC quirks. Codes, field definitions, date conventions: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_insider_transactions

ticker.description: Case-insensitive; also searches the issuer's former symbols.

officer_name.description: Owner-name substring, case-insensitive; alias of reporting_owner_name. 1-2 letters: whole word, newest 5,000 rows only.

transaction_type.description: Open-market direction only (null on grants, transfers, derivatives). Sets include_non_open_market=false by default.

is_derivative.description: true = derivative rows, false = common stock. Works on BOTH data_sources.

transaction_codes.description: OR-filter on SEC codes: P purchase, S sale (open market or private), A grant, M/X exercise, C conversion, F price or tax paid in shares, G gift, D to issuer, I 401(k)/ESPP, V voluntary. Alias trans_codes. Works on BOTH data_sources.

min_value.description: total_value >= this (USD). Works on BOTH data_sources. Rows with no derivable value are EXCLUDED unless include_unpriced.

include_unpriced.description: With min_value, bulk_v2 only: keep rows that state no price.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor, verbatim, same sort. offset and page are rejected.

sort_by.description: Also the since/until field. Default disclosure_date (filing_date on bulk_v2). total_value: legacy only.

include_baseline.description: Add Form 3 starting positions under baselines. Needs ticker or company_cik.

merge_co_reports.description: Default true: one row when a fund, its GP and its controller each file the same trade. false = one per filing.

data_source.description: bulk_v2 (default, authoritative) or legacy: the daily scraper's store, from 2016 with large gaps 2022 to 2026.

reporting_owner_name.description: bulk_v2 only. Without ticker, company_cik or reporting_owner_cik it scans recent filings only.

trans_codes.description: Alias of transaction_codes, accepted on either data_source.

aff10b5one.description: bulk_v2 only. 10b5-1 box: 1 plan, 0 none, '' blank, NOT_TRACKED before 2023.

schema_era.description: bulk_v2 only. By filing quarter, not trade date.

include_non_open_market.description: false: OPEN_MARKET plus unclassified rows only. Default false with transaction_type, else true.

tools.name: get_institutional_holdings
tools.description: Returns SEC Form 13F holdings: the quarterly long-equity positions of every institutional investment manager that files a 13F ($100M+ in 13(f) securities), whole books, every quarter since 2013-06-30. Each record is one (fund, security, quarter). 13F does NOT include short positions, cash, most options, or non-US-listed equities. USD. market_value null = units unconfirmed (value_as_filed: as filed); they skip value sorts and min_value. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_institutional_holdings

ticker.description: Follows the security across a ticker change.

fund_name.description: Substring, 3+ characters, of any name filed under (query.resolved_fund_ciks); over 20 managers: FILTER_REQUIRED.

quarter.description: Period end, YYYY-MM-DD. Default all quarters; with no filter at all, the latest complete quarter.

position_change.description: Vs prior quarter (INSUFFICIENT_DATA: not comparable). Needs a fund or security.

sort_by.description: Default market_value. shares_held and shares_change_pct need a quarter plus a fund or security.

cursor.description: Prior next_cursor, verbatim, same filters and sort.

tools.name: get_congressional_trades
tools.description: Returns trade records disclosed by U.S. members of Congress under the STOCK Act (Senate eFD and House Clerk Periodic Transaction Reports): one disclosed transaction by a member or their immediate family per row. The same filings are published free as news at https://keyvex.com/disclosures under 5 U.S.C. § 13107(c). These are DISCLOSED trades, filed up to 45 days late: disclosure_date is when the public could first see the trade, transaction_date when it happened. Amounts are STOCK Act ranges (e.g. '$1,001 - $15,000'); amount_min and amount_max hold the bounds. Each record's party is the party the member held on the date of the record (a trade's transaction date, a disclosure's filing date); for a date outside the member's terms in office, the party of their nearest term (the last one before that date, or the first one after it). Amendments, superseded rows and non-market events: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_congressional_trades

bioguide_id.description: Congressional ID, e.g. 'C001035'; preferred over member_name.

transaction_type.description: buy = Purchase (P); sell = full or partial Sale (S); exchange = Exchange (E). Omit for all three.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

min_amount.description: amount_min >= this (USD): the range's lower bound.

sort_by.description: Also the since/until field. Default disclosure_date.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor, verbatim; keep filters and sort identical.

amendment_status.description: Default all. Most amendment rows add disclosures, not duplicates. Every House row is 'unknown'.

exclude_superseded.description: Drop originals a later amendment restates. Default false: SET IT WHEN SUMMING AMOUNTS, or totals double-count.

include_non_open_market.description: false: market trades plus unclassified rows only (no gifts). Default false with transaction_type, else true.

tools.name: get_planned_insider_sales
tools.description: SEC Form 144 notices of proposed sale by insiders (officers, directors, 10%+ holders): one row per planned-sale line of a filing. aggregate_market_value and approximate_sale_date are the filer's estimates; the value is as filed: null = not stated (a filed 0 stays 0), and some filers state the issuer's market cap. aggregate_market_value_check says which ('checked' = implies a plausible price; misses some). A ticker search also covers symbols the issuer no longer lists. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_planned_insider_sales

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

sort_by.description: Default filing_date. A value sort takes no since/until; nulls last.

tools.name: get_activist_stakes
tools.description: Schedule 13D/13G filings by holders of 5%+ of a class of registered equity, from January 2024 (none earlier). One row per reporting person per filing; joint filings share accession_number. is_activist true: 13D, intent to influence control; false: 13G, passive. An exit amendment (below 5%) has shares_owned 0 and percent_of_class 0: an exit, not missing data. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_activist_stakes

include_filing_narrative.description: Default false; true adds the 13D narrative, Items 2, 3, 4 (purpose) and 6 (long).

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date; with a numeric sort_by, refused (INVALID_QUERY).

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date; with a numeric sort_by, refused.

tools.name: get_federal_contracts
tools.description: Federal prime contract awards (types A-D) from api.usaspending.gov, queried live over the full dataset (October 2007 on); in an outage, a recent cached window (source 'cache'). One row per award; award_amount includes modifications to date. award_amount and total_outlays may be null (not reported), not $0. total_count is USAspending's count for the whole query. recipient_uei.description: 12 characters; that UEI's own awards only.

awarding_agency.description: Exact, case-sensitive TOPTIER name, e.g. 'Department of Defense' (not 'DoD').

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on last_modified_date, or start_date if sorted by it.

tools.name: get_federal_grants
tools.description: Federal grants and cooperative agreements (award types 02-05) from api.usaspending.gov, queried live over the full dataset (October 2007 on); in an outage, a recent cached window (source 'cache'). award_amount and total_outlays may be null (not reported), not $0. total_count is USAspending's count for the whole query. Detail: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_federal_grants

recipient_name.description: Case-insensitive substring; also matches parent names.

recipient_uei.description: 12 characters; that UEI's own grants only.

awarding_agency.description: Exact, case-sensitive TOPTIER name, e.g. 'Department of Energy' (not 'DOE').

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on last_modified_date, or start_date if sorted by it.

tools.name: get_member_profile
tools.description: Current members of Congress from the unitedstates/congress-legislators catalog, one row per member keyed by bioguide_id: party, state, district, terms, committees. Filters combine; sorted by full_name. photo_url is KeyVex's metered portrait endpoint. Codes and fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_member_profile

tools.name: get_material_events
tools.description: SEC Form 8-K current reports: one row per filing; item_codes say what it covers (1.01 material agreement, 2.02 results, 5.02 officer/director change; 9.01 exhibits is on nearly every 8-K). Full coverage from 2026-05-01; before it a thin slice (about 1%), and coverage_warning says so. 8-K/A amendments are their own rows. Body text: primary_document_url. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_material_events

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date.

sort_by.description: Default filing_date. period_of_report (event date) re-sorts the filing_date page.

tools.name: get_lobbying_filings
tools.description: Lobbying Disclosure Act LD-2 filings (lda.gov), filing year 2016 on: one row per registrant, client and period, with issues, entities contacted and lobbyists. Firms report income, in-house lobbyists expenses (never both), so sort_by=income and min_income see income filers only. Name and entity filters: case-insensitive substring. Detail: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_lobbying_filings

filing_period.description: LD-2 is quarterly; mid_year/year_end are semiannual.

general_issue_codes.description: LDA issue codes, any of (max 30): DEF defense, HCR health, TAX taxes, etc.

tools.name: get_lobbyist_contributions
tools.description: LD-203 reports (Senate LDA, filing year 2008 on): what lobbyists and their firms give, each item naming the HONOREE (covered official). One row per filing. 'No contributions' certifications (about half) are excluded unless include_empty=true. Name filters: case-insensitive substring. Fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_lobbyist_contributions

contribution_type.description: Exact LDA code: 'feca' FECA campaign contribution, 'he' Honorary Expenses, 'me' Meeting Expenses, 'ple' Presidential Library Expenses, 'pic' Presidential Inaugural Committee.

filer_type.description: 'lobbyist': an individual lobbyist's report; 'registrant': a firm's report (stored as 'organization').

tools.name: get_annual_financial_disclosures
tools.description: Form 278 annual financial disclosures of members of Congress and congressional candidates, one row per filing. The same filings are published free as news at https://keyvex.com/disclosures under 5 U.S.C. § 13107(c). Parsed rows carry assets[] and liabilities[] as disclosed RANGES; a House row KeyVex may have misread carries parse_unreliable: true. Fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_annual_financial_disclosures

party.description: Exact match on the record's party, where the party is the party the member held on the date of the record (a trade's transaction date, a disclosure's filing date); for a date outside the member's terms in office, the party of their nearest term (the last one before that date, or the first one after it). Here: filing_date.

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort field; refused with sort_by=filing_year.

tools.name: get_fec_candidate_profile
tools.description: FEC-registered candidates (House, Senate, President) from api.open.fec.gov, active in the three most recent cycles, refreshed weekly. include_committees adds committees[], principal campaign committee (designation 'P') first. Codes: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fec_candidate_profile

office.description: H House, S Senate, P President.

district.description: House district, 2 digits: '01', or '00' for at-large.

party.description: FEC code, exact, e.g. DEM, REP, LIB.

active_only.description: true = candidate_inactive is false. Default false.

tools.name: get_fec_contributions
tools.description: FEC Schedule A contributions (money INTO federal committees), AGGREGATED. Individual donors are never exposed as searchable per-record rows: the FEC sale-or-use rule (11 CFR 104.15) permits aggregated presentation only. NO NATURAL PERSON IS NAMED BY THIS TOOL, IN ANY MODE. A paid service ranking named individuals by their contribution history is a prohibited commercial use of contributor lists (11 CFR 104.15; 52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4)). No contributor_name search and no street, city or ZIP, by design. Live from api.open.fec.gov with a cached fallback (source: live | cache). Three modes: (1) group_by: totals by employer, state, candidate, committee or cycle; on employer and state rows contribution_count counts contributions, not contributors. (2) leaderboard=true: top ORGANISATION donors in one scope, plus the individual side as count and total only, NO median and NO maximum, withheld entirely when fewer than 5 individuals gave. (3) entity_type or sub_id: per-record rows for non-individual contributors only. Modes and fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fec_contributions

group_by.description: employer/state need recipient_committee_id + cycle; cycle needs candidate_id or recipient_committee_id.

leaderboard.description: Top ORGANISATION donors in one scope, plus individual count and total only (NO median, NO maximum). Needs cycle + exactly one scope parameter.

contributor_state.description: 2-letter state: leaderboard scope or per-record filter.

entity_type.description: Per-record mode, non-individual types only; IND, UNK and CAN (a candidate, a natural person) are refused.

sub_id.description: Per-record lookup; returned only if non-individual.

cycle.description: 2-year cycle, e.g. 2026. Required for leaderboard and employer/state; candidate defaults to the current one.

min_amount.description: Per-record: inclusive lower bound on amount. Rejected in leaderboard mode (its floor is a fixed $1,000).

max_amount.description: Per-record: inclusive upper bound on amount.

exclude_memos.description: Per-record, default true: drop memo subtotals (they double-count).

tools.name: get_fec_disbursements
tools.description: FEC Schedule B disbursements: itemized money OUT of a federal committee, live from api.open.fec.gov (else a cached $1,000+ subset). ORGANISATIONS ONLY: per-record rows are served only when FEC codes the payee as a committee or organisation. Rows naming a natural person — individual payees (IND), candidates (CAN), unclassified payees, and people a filer coded as an organisation — are withheld per record under the FEC sale-or-use rule (11 CFR 104.15). Refunds of contributions to individuals are withheld with them. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on disbursement_date. Fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fec_disbursements

entity_type.description: COM committee, CCM candidate committee, PTY party, ORG organization.

exclude_memos.description: Default true: drops double-counting memo rows.

tools.name: get_fec_independent_expenditures
tools.description: FEC Schedule E independent expenditures (api.open.fec.gov): uncoordinated spending FOR ('S') or AGAINST ('O') a federal candidate. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on expenditure_date. Filers FEC classes as "a person or a group" (Form 5 filers, committee types I and E) are served when the filer is a group; a filer whose name is, or may be, a natural person's is withheld per record, as is any filer KeyVex holds no committee record for (FEC sale-or-use rule, 11 CFR 104.15). Fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fec_independent_expenditures

support_oppose.description: S support, O oppose. Omit for both.

cycle.description: Undercounts (often null at FEC); prefer dates.

exclude_memos.description: Default true: drops double-counting memo rows.

tools.name: get_tender_offers
tools.description: SEC Schedule TO tender offers: SC TO-T (third-party bid for a company's shares), SC TO-I (issuer buyback) and their /A amendments. One row per filing, metadata only; offer terms are at primary_document_url. An amendment chain shares file_number (a field, not a filter). since/until (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on filing_date), target_name and bidder_name apply within the newest max(500, 4 x limit) filings the other filters select, 2,000 with a name filter; coverage_warning says so. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_tender_offers

tools.name: get_bills
tools.description: Congressional bills and resolutions from api.congress.gov (Library of Congress), refreshed daily for the current and previous Congress. Metadata only: sponsors, text and summaries are at api_url and congress_gov_url. bill_id is '{congress}-{TYPE}-{number}', e.g. '119-HR-134'. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive: since/until on latest_action_date, introduced_* on introduction_date. Detail: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_bills

bill_type.description: HR/S bills; *RES simple, *JRES joint, *CONRES concurrent resolutions.

tools.name: get_roll_call_votes
tools.description: Roll-call votes, House (api.congress.gov) and Senate (senate.gov XML), one row per vote; no voice votes and no per-member positions (see source_data_url). While senate.gov refuses our requests, new Senate votes may come from Voteview (source 'voteview'). vote_id is '{chamber}-{congress}-{session}-{number}', e.g. 'house-119-1-240'. Fields: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_roll_call_votes

legislation_type.description: HR/S bills; *RES simple, *JRES joint, *CONRES concurrent resolutions.

tools.name: get_private_placements
tools.description: SEC Form D exempt-offering notices (Reg D 504/506, Section 4(a)): one row per filing. Amounts: null = not stated, 0 = stated zero; rows stored before 2026-08-17 cannot tell which. Null fails min_amount_sold, sorts last. Only filing_id, issuer_cik, issuer_state, federal_exemption, is_amendment and a 4+ character issuer_name search all filings; other filters and sorts use the newest 2,000 those select (coverage_warning says so). More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_private_placements

tools.name: get_crowdfunding_offerings
tools.description: SEC Form C Regulation Crowdfunding filings, 2016-05 on: one row per filing with issuer, portal, offering terms and disclosed financials (USD; null where a form omits them). filing_type: offering (C, C/A), progress_update (C-U), annual_report (C-AR), termination (C-TR). Form C financials are self-reported and generally unaudited (reviewed at most). since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on filing_date. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_crowdfunding_offerings

tools.name: get_reg_a_offerings
tools.description: SEC Form 1-A Regulation A+ offering statements, 2015-06 on: one row per filing with issuer, tier, terms, service-provider fees and Part I financials as filed. Forms: 1-A initial, 1-A/A amendment, 1-A POS post-qualification amendment, -W withdrawal. 1-K, 1-SA and 1-Z reports are not included. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on filing_date. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_reg_a_offerings

tier.description: Tier1: up to $20M, state review; Tier2: up to $75M, no state review.

tools.name: get_product_recalls
tools.description: Federal safety recalls: FDA drug, device and food recalls (Class I most severe, II, III), CPSC consumer-product recalls, and NHTSA vehicle, equipment, tire and child-restraint campaigns since 1966. One row per recall, id {source}-{recall_number}. classification is FDA-only: setting it excludes all CPSC and NHTSA rows. FDA rows typically run 4-6 weeks behind real-world recall dates (openFDA's cadence) while CPSC is current: filter by source for FDA. Search rule for recalling_firm, product_description and vehicle_model: case-insensitive; 4+ characters match anywhere, 1-3 characters match a whole word; a term of 3+ characters searches every recall, and a 1-2 character term searches only the newest 5,000 recalls the query's other filters select (the oldest, with sort_order=asc), and coverage_warning says so. NHTSA: do_not_drive and park_outside are NHTSA's owner advisories; source=nhtsa with recall_number lists the campaign's vehicles. Source: NHTSA Office of Defects Investigation; public domain (http://www.usa.gov/publicdomain/label/1.0/). Fields and sources: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_product_recalls

recall_number.description: As filed (FDA 'D-1234-2026', NHTSA '26V652000'); with source, a direct lookup.

recalling_firm.description: Firm name; search rule in the description.

product_description.description: Product text; search rule in the description.

classification.description: FDA only: setting it excludes CPSC and NHTSA rows.

vehicle_make.description: NHTSA only. Exact make, case- and space-insensitive.

vehicle_model.description: NHTSA only. Model text; search rule in the description.

vehicles_cursor.description: With source=nhtsa and recall_number: the previous vehicles_next_cursor.

tools.name: get_fda_approvals
tools.description: One row per FDA decision. source drugsfda: Drugs@FDA actions from 1939 (decision_code AP approved, TA tentative: blocked by patent/exclusivity); 510k: device clearances from 1976 (SESE cleared); pma: Class III device approvals from 1960 (APPR approved, OK30 30-day supplement accepted). review_priority PRIORITY/STANDARD: drugs; EXPEDITED: devices. No ticker or CIK: applicant is the name as filed. applicant, product_name: case-insensitive substring (1-3 chars: whole word) in a 5,000-row window. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fda_approvals

tools.name: get_drug_adverse_events
tools.description: FDA FAERS adverse-event reports (2004 on), live from openFDA, fields verbatim (5-15 KB records); total_count: openFDA's count. count_by: top terms with counts, not records. FDA: FAERS reports are unverified and establish NEITHER causation NOR incidence; counts are a reporting signal, not a risk measure. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_drug_adverse_events

tools.name: get_bank_financials
tools.description: Quarterly FDIC financials (Call Reports) for every FDIC-insured US bank, 1984 on: one row per bank (the insured bank, not its holding company) per quarter-end. Amounts in $ THOUSANDS; ratios in percent (FDIC's, annualized). Income items are YEAR-TO-DATE (Q3 = nine months); roe_quarterly is one quarter. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on report_date. Defaults: report_date desc, 50 rows. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_bank_financials

cert.description: FDIC certificate #, the stable bank key.

name.description: Name part, any case; 1-3 chars = whole word.

tools.name: get_enforcement_actions
tools.description: Enforcement actions from eight regulators: SEC, DOJ, CFTC, OCC, FDIC, FTC, Federal Reserve and FinCEN. Every row is labelled category: "enforcement" (charges, suits, settlements, penalties, orders; every DOJ, Federal Reserve and FinCEN row) or "agency_news" (rules, appointments, speeches, bank-failure notices). By DEFAULT only enforcement is returned; pass category="all" for everything, or category="agency_news" for the news alone. A direct action_id lookup returns the row whatever its category. Rows carry metadata, a teaser and a description capped near 3,000 characters (none for CFTC); the full text is at url. KeyVex adds no severity or outcome signal. SEC, CFTC and FTC are rolling recent windows; Federal Reserve and FinCEN are full history. Sources and ID formats: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_enforcement_actions

text.description: Substring of title, teaser and description, case-insensitive: names of companies or people.

agency_component.description: Substring: the DOJ issuing division, or for fed the bank. Empty for most other sources.

topic.description: Exact topics[] tag: DOJ topic, Fed action type or FinCEN institution category.

tools.name: get_epa_enforcement
tools.description: EPA federal civil enforcement cases from ICIS FE&C via ECHO (weekly), a row each: EPA-lead administrative and judicial actions only (no criminal, no state-lead). status_date is the last status change. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_epa_enforcement

primary_statute.description: Lead statute: CWA Clean Water, CAA Clean Air, RCRA hazardous waste, CERCLA Superfund, TSCA toxic substances, FIFRA pesticides, SDWA drinking water, EPCRA right-to-know; rare: AIM, MPRSA, MWTA.

tools.name: get_nport_filings
tools.description: SEC Form N-PORT filings (NPORT-P, NPORT-P/A amendments) filed from 2024-06-01: one row per monthly portfolio report of a fund trust. period_ending = the month covered (filed up to 60 days later). Per-security holdings: get_fund_holdings, same filing_id. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on file_date. Defaults: sort file_date desc, limit 50. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_nport_filings

filer_name.description: Trust name part, any case; 1-3 chars = whole word.

is_amendment.description: true: NPORT-P/A only; false: NPORT-P only.

tools.name: get_money_market_funds
tools.description: SEC N-MFP money-market fund reports since 2010-11, as filed: one row per fund series per month (category, net assets, WAM/WAL days, liquid-asset fractions of 1, stable NAV). Monthly flows exist only on N-MFP3 (2024-06 on), summed over the share classes that reported (flows_basis, flows_classes_reporting_*); earlier rows: null. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_money_market_funds

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description:
Your watchlist alerts, newest first, for the account that owns the calling API key (no argument selects an
account). Kinds:
  congress_trade: a congressional trade disclosed this week in a ticker or by a member on your watchlist.
  initial_13d: an initial Schedule 13D (a new 5%+ activist stake) filed this week in a ticker on your watchlist.
  federal_contract: federal awards at or above your threshold that KeyVex first reported this week, new or newly modified (a later modification of an award you were already alerted to does not alert again).
An event alerts only when its own date is within 7 days of detection and not before you added the entry. `data`
is the source record as KeyVex stored it when the alert fired, with KeyVex's internal `_` fields removed.
Webhooks (paid plans, Basic and up): REJECT a timestamp older than 5 minutes; signing: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_alerts
